senses.title: The organ

items.en: Heorte named the physical heart.

normal.en: His heart beat faster.

examples.en: His heart was beating fast.

senses.title: A device that warms a room
senses.definition: a device that makes the air in a room or building warmer
senses.definitionCN: 让房间或建筑物里的空气变暖的装置
senses.example: She turned on the electric heater before getting out of bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她起床前先打开了电暖器。
senses.why: The suffix -er means a thing that does the action, so a heater is literally the thing that heats.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -er 表示「做某动作的东西」，heater 字面上就是「用来加热的东西」，最常见的就是给房间供暖的设备。

senses.title: The heating unit of a machine or vehicle
senses.titleCN: 机器或车内的暖气；加热部件
senses.definition: the part of a machine or vehicle that provides warm air
senses.definitionCN: 机器或车辆里提供暖空气的部件
senses.example: The heater in my car stopped working during the cold wave.
senses.exampleCN: 寒潮期间我车里的暖气坏了。
senses.why: Any machine that needs warmth carries a built-in unit that heats, and the -er suffix names that unit.
senses.whyCN: 任何需要热量的机器内部都装着一个负责加热的小部件，-er 后缀正好用来命名这个部件。

senses.title: A device that heats water
senses.definition: a device that warms water for washing or other uses
senses.definitionCN: 为洗漱或其他用途把水加热的设备
senses.example: Our water heater broke down, so we had to take cold showers.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的热水器坏了，只好洗冷水澡。
senses.why: The same naming rule applies to heating water: the device that heats is called a heater.
senses.whyCN: 同样的命名规则也适用于加热水：凡是负责加热的装置，一律用 heater 来称呼。

senses.title: A device for heating food or drink
senses.titleCN: 食物或饮品的加热器具
senses.definition: a small device used to warm food, drink, or baby bottles
senses.definitionCN: 用来加热食物、饮品或奶瓶的小型器具
senses.example: The campers used a portable heater to warm their soup.
senses.exampleCN: 露营的人用便携加热器热汤。
senses.why: Anything whose job is to heat, however small, earns the -er name of doer.
senses.whyCN: 只要职责是加热，哪怕体积很小，也同样按「加热者」的构词规则得名。

senses.title: An industrial heating unit
senses.titleCN: 工业加热炉；工业加热装置
senses.definition: a large piece of equipment that heats materials in factories or furnaces
senses.definitionCN: 工厂或熔炉里给物料加热的大型设备
senses.example: The steel plant replaced its old heater with a more efficient one.
senses.exampleCN: 钢厂用更高效的新加热炉换掉了旧设备。
senses.why: The naming rule scales up: large industrial machines that heat are still called heaters.
senses.whyCN: 命名规则可以放大：即使是给物料加热的大型工业机器，也沿用 heater 这个称呼。

senses.title: An engine starter aid in cold weather
senses.definition: a device that warms an engine before it starts in cold weather
senses.definitionCN: 寒冷天气下在启动前给发动机预热（或辅助预热）的装置
senses.example: Drivers in the north often plug in an engine heater on winter nights.
senses.exampleCN: 北方的司机冬夜里常给发动机预热器插电。
senses.why: Warming an engine before starting is still heating, so the device inherits the same name.
senses.whyCN: 启动前给发动机升温本质上仍是加热，所以这类装置顺理成章继承了同一个名字。

senses.title: A component that keeps a temperature steady
senses.definition: a component inside an appliance that keeps something at a set temperature
senses.definitionCN: 电器内部把某物维持在设定温度的元件
senses.example: The aquarium heater keeps the water at a constant temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼缸加热棒让水温保持恒定。
senses.why: Keeping warm is the same job as heating, so the word covers steady-temperature devices too.
senses.whyCN: 「保温」与「加热」本是同一件事的两面，所以这个词也覆盖维持恒温的元件。

senses.title: Figurative: a source of warmth or comfort
senses.titleCN: 比喻：带来温暖的人或事物
senses.definition: a person or thing that gives emotional warmth, used playfully
senses.definitionCN: 口语戏称给人带来温暖和安全感的人或事物
senses.example: Her hugs were the best heater in the freezing classroom.
senses.exampleCN: 在冰冷的教室里，她的拥抱就是最棒的暖炉。
senses.why: Because the core image is producing warmth, people borrow the word to describe emotional warmth.
senses.whyCN: 因为核心意象是「制造温暖」，人们顺势借用这个词来戏称带来情感温暖的人或物。

intro.en: Heater is a transparent English formation: the verb heat plus the agent suffix -er, first recorded as a device name in the early nineteenth century.
intro.cn: heater 是一个构词一目了然的英语词：动词 heat 加表「施动者／工具」的后缀 -er，作为设备名称首见于十九世纪初。

items.en: The verb heat goes back to the reconstructed Proto-Germanic form *haitjan, meaning to make hot, built on the root *hait- hot.
items.cn: 动词 heat 可追溯到重构的原始日耳曼语形式 *haitjan，义为「使变热」，建立在表「热」的词根 *hait- 之上。

items.en: Old English had hat, meaning hot, and hatian, meaning to become hot; the causative idea of making something hot developed alongside it.
items.cn: 古英语中有 hat（热的）和 hatian（变热），「使某物变热」的使动含义随之发展。

items.en: In Middle English the verb appeared as heten, and the form heat gradually settled into standard use by the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 中古英语时期动词写作 heten，到十六世纪 heat 这一形式逐渐定型为标准用法。

items.en: The suffix -er, from Old English -ere, marks a person or thing that performs an action, making heater mean the thing that heats.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 来自古英语 -ere，标记执行动作的人或物，于是 heater 的字面义就是「用来加热的东西」。

items.en: As an everyday device name, heater became common in the early nineteenth century with the spread of stoves, boilers, and domestic warming equipment.
items.cn: 作为日常设备名，heater 在十九世纪初随着炉具、锅炉和家用取暖设备的普及而变得常见。

items.en: Today heater covers everything from car heaters and water heaters to space heaters, wherever the job is producing warmth.
items.cn: 如今从车载暖气、热水器到空间取暖器，凡以产生热量为职责的设备，都可以叫 heater。

note.en: Heater belongs to the small heat word family; be careful to tell it apart from look-alike words that merely share a spelling shape.
note.cn: heater 属于小小的「热」词族；注意把它与只是拼写形状相似的词区分开。

entries.definition: the quality of being hot, or the act of making something hot
entries.definitionCN: 热；高温；加热（heater 的基础动词与名词）

entries.definition: the system or process of keeping a building warm
entries.definitionCN: 供暖；供暖系统（由 heat 加 -ing 构成）

entries.definition: having no heater; rare descriptive form
entries.definitionCN: 无加热装置的（少见描述性形式，由 heater 加 -less 构成）

entries.definition: the floor of a fireplace; the area in front of it
entries.definitionCN: 壁炉地面；炉边——只是拼写与读音相近，词源不同，勿混淆

entries.definition: loud, cheerful, and full of energy
entries.definitionCN: 热情的； hearty 与 heart 同源，与 heater 只是拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a device that burns fuel or uses electricity for cooking or warming a room
entries.definitionCN: 炉子；炉灶（侧重烹饪，也可取暖）

entries.definition: an enclosed chamber for very high heat, in industry or home heating
entries.definitionCN: 熔炉；暖气锅炉（规模更大、温度更高）

entries.definition: a device that gives out heat from hot water or steam inside it
entries.definitionCN: 暖气片；散热器（以辐射方式散热的供暖设备）

entries.definition: a tank or device that heats water, especially for a heating system
entries.definitionCN: 锅炉；热水器（侧重加热水供供暖使用）

entries.definition: a small device or container that keeps something warm
entries.definitionCN: 保温器；保温容器（侧重保温而非强力加热）

normalIntro.en: Build the word from its two visible parts and connect each memory to a real device you have used.
normalIntro.cn: 把这个词拆成两个看得见的部分来记，并把每条联想连到你真实用过的设备上。

normal.en: heat + er = the thing that heats; the -er suffix names the doer or tool.
normal.cn: heat（加热）+ -er（做……的东西）＝加热器；-er 是「执行者」后缀。

normal.en: Same pattern as cooker, cooler, and dryer: appliance names love the -er suffix.
normal.cn: 与 cooker（炊具）、cooler（冰箱）、dryer（烘干机）同一构词法：家电名偏爱 -er 后缀。

normal.en: water heater, space heater, car heater: the compound tells you what it heats.
normal.cn: water heater（热水器）、space heater（取暖器）、car heater（车载暖气）：复合词告诉你它加热什么。

normal.en: Winter scene memory: when the room is cold, you turn on the heater, so heater belongs to cold days.
normal.cn: 冬景记忆法：屋里一冷就打开 heater，让这个词和寒冷的冬天绑定在一起。

normal.en: Compare with heat itself: heat is the warmth, heater is the machine that makes the warmth.
normal.cn: 与 heat 对比记忆：heat 是热本身，heater 是制造热的机器。

abstract.en: Picture a little machine with arms, hugging cold air and pushing it out warm.
abstract.cn: 想象一台长着手臂的小机器，抱住冷空气，再把暖风推出来。

abstract.en: See a red switch glowing on a snowy night; the switch is the heater waking up.
abstract.cn: 雪夜里一个发红光的开关亮起，那是 heater 正在苏醒。

abstract.en: Think of -er as a tiny worker label: heater is the worker whose only job is heat.
abstract.cn: 把 -er 想成小工人标签：heater 就是唯一职责是「加热」的那名工人。

examples.en: Please turn off the heater before you leave the office.
examples.cn: 离开办公室前请关掉取暖器。

examples.en: The water heater in our flat broke down again this winter.
examples.cn: 今年冬天我们公寓的热水器又坏了。

examples.en: A gentle rain fell all afternoon and the wind grew cold.
examples.cn: 细雨下了一下午，风越来越冷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「黑特儿」——屋子里黑黑的特别冷，赶紧打开「黑特儿」（加热器）取暖；谐音仅助记，heater 实际由 heat 加 -er 构成。

root: heater 是地道的英语本土构词：词根为古英语 hat（热的）与动词 hatian（变热），中英语发展为 heten，现代英语定型为动词 heat（加热）；后缀 -er 来自古英语 -ere，表「做某事的人或物」。heat + -er ＝「用来加热的装置」。无拉丁或希腊词根，构词完全透明。

sensesIntro.en: From the core image of a device that produces warmth, heater spreads to room heaters, car heaters, water heaters, small warming tools, industrial units, engine pre-warmers, steady-temperature parts, and playful figurative uses.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「制造温暖的装置」这一核心意象出发，heater 依次覆盖房间取暖器、车载暖气、热水器、小型加热器具、工业加热炉、发动机预热器、恒温元件，以及戏称带来温暖的比喻用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a device whose only job is to make something warmer
core.cn: 核心意象：一台唯一职责是把东西变暖的装置

branches.en: Room and space warming devices, the most common everyday use
branches.cn: 房间与空间取暖设备，最常见的日常用法

branches.en: Heating units inside machines and vehicles, including engine pre-warmers
branches.cn: 机器与车辆内部的加热部件，包括发动机预热器

branches.en: Devices that heat water, food, drink, or baby bottles
branches.cn: 加热水、食物、饮品或奶瓶的器具

branches.en: Large industrial heating units and steady-temperature components
branches.cn: 大型工业加热炉与维持恒温的元件

branches.en: Playful figurative use for a person or thing that gives emotional warmth
branches.cn: 戏称带来情感温暖的人或物的比喻用法

intro.en: Heater is built from a native English verb plus one productive suffix; the same pattern names dozens of household appliances.
intro.cn: heater 由一个英语本土动词加一个高产后缀构成；同样的模式命名了几十种家用电器。

latinIntro.en: Heater has no Latin root of its own, but the -er agent idea and the heat concept connect it to Latin-derived relatives worth knowing.
latinIntro.cn: heater 本身没有拉丁词根，但「-er 施动者」的思路和「热」的概念能把它与拉丁来源的相关词联系起来。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does an action
items.exampleCN: 加热器、炊具、打印机都以此后缀命名

items.meaning: the act or system of doing something

items.meaningCN: 热（希腊来源，与 heat 概念相对）

items.meaning: a thing that does an action, Latin counterpart of -er
items.meaningCN: 做某动作之物（-er 的拉丁对应形式）

latinEntries.exampleCN: 熔炉；锅炉——经由古法语传入英语

definition_en: the home of God in many religions, the sky, or a very pleasant place
core_image: 云层之上光亮开阔的所在，安宁而明亮
scene: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
sceneCN: 这里 heaven 是「天堂」（第 1 个义项）；句意：奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。

senses.title: The home of God
senses.definition: the place where God and good souls are said to live
senses.definitionCN: 宗教中上帝与善者所在之处
senses.example: Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。
senses.why: This is the religious sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是宗教意义上的天堂。

senses.title: The sky
senses.definition: the sky, especially in older or poetic use
senses.definitionCN: 天空，尤其用于较古或诗意的表达
senses.example: The stars filled the heavens.
senses.why: Heaven was once simply the sky above.
senses.whyCN: heaven 原本就指头顶的天空。

senses.title: A perfect place
senses.definition: a very pleasant place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 非常舒适愉快的地方或处境
senses.example: This quiet beach is heaven.
senses.exampleCN: 这片安静的海滩就是天堂。
senses.why: Any place that feels perfect borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 任何让人感到完美的地方，都借用了这个名字。

intro.en: Heaven comes from Old English heofon, the sky.
intro.cn: heaven 来自古英语 heofon，意为天空。

items.en: Heofon named the sky above.
items.cn: heofon 指头顶的天空。

items.en: The word may have meant the lifted roof.
items.cn: 这个词可能本指被抬起的屋顶。

items.en: Heven also named the home of God.
items.cn: 中古英语 heven 也指上帝所在之处。

items.en: The heavens still mean the night sky.
items.cn: the heavens 仍指夜空。

items.en: Any blissful place can be called heaven.
items.cn: 任何极乐之地都可称作 heaven。

note.en: Heaven is compared with look-alike words and with words for a perfect place.
note.cn: 把 heaven 与形近词以及表示美好之地的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heaven begins as the sky and becomes the best place we can imagine.
normalIntro.cn: heaven 从天空开始，最后成了我们能想象的最好地方。

normal.en: They believed he went to heaven.
The heavens were full of stars.
Thank heaven you are safe.
This garden is heaven in summer.
normal.cn: 夏天的这座花园就是天堂。

normal.en: Their teamwork was a match made in heaven.
normal.cn: 他们的合作是天作之合。

abstract.en: Heaven is the sky given a promise.
abstract.cn: 天堂，是被许下承诺的天空。

abstract.en: We build heaven out of what we miss.
abstract.cn: 我们用所缺之物，造出天堂。

abstract.en: A quiet afternoon can open the gate.
abstract.cn: 一个安静的午后，也能推开那扇门。

examples.en: Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
examples.cn: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。

examples.en: The stars filled the heavens.
This quiet beach is heaven.
examples.cn: 这片安静的海滩就是天堂。

dict_mnemonic.text: heaven 本是「天空」，宗教把最好的归宿放在天上，于是成了「天堂」；任何舒服得像天堂的地方，也可以直接叫 heaven。

root: 来自古英语 heofon（天空），属日耳曼语词，可能本指「被抬起的屋顶」；由头顶的天空，引申为神灵居所的天堂，再泛指极乐之地。

sensesIntro.en: Heaven is the sky overhead, the promised home of God, and any place that feels perfect.
sensesIntro.cn: heaven 是头顶的天空、应许的神居之所，以及任何完美得像天堂的地方。

core.en: Bright open space above the clouds.
core.cn: 云层之上明亮开阔的地方。

branches.en: A promise is made about the afterlife.
branches.cn: 人们许下关于身后归宿的承诺。

branches.en: Stars fill the night above.
branches.cn: 星星布满头顶的夜空。

branches.en: A hammock sways by the sea.
branches.cn: 吊床在海边轻轻摇晃。

branches.en: The sky above becomes the home beyond.
branches.cn: 头顶的天，成了远方的家。

branches.en: A perfect day feels like open sky.
branches.cn: 完美的一天，像敞开的天空。

intro.en: Heaven builds an adjective, an adverb, and a plural.
intro.cn: heaven 构成形容词、副词与复数形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root in the everyday word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个日常词没有拉丁词根。

items.meaning: the sky or home of God

items.example: They believe he is in heaven.

definition_en: in a heavy way, in large amounts, or to a serious degree
core_image: 雨点密集砸下，走路的人被压得弯下肩
scene: 雨下得很大。It was raining heavily.
sceneCN: 这里 heavily 是「大量地」（第 2 个义项）；句意：雨下得很大。

senses.title: With weight
senses.definition: in a way that shows weight or effort
senses.definitionCN: 显出重量或费力地
senses.example: He walked heavily up the stairs.
senses.why: The body carries weight here.
senses.whyCN: 这里身体承载着重量。

senses.title: In large amounts
senses.definition: in large amounts or with great force
senses.definitionCN: 数量很大或力度很强地
senses.example: It was raining heavily.
senses.why: Rain falls in heavy drops.
senses.whyCN: 雨以沉重的雨点落下。

senses.title: To a serious degree
senses.definition: to a great or serious degree
senses.definitionCN: 达到很大或严重的程度
senses.example: The town was heavily damaged by the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 这座镇子被洪水严重破坏。
senses.why: The effect presses down like a weight.
senses.whyCN: 影响像重量一样压下来。

intro.en: Heavily is heavy plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: heavily 由 heavy 加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Hefig meant heavy or weighed down.
items.cn: hefig 意为重的、被压住的。

items.en: Hevy kept the sense of weight.
items.cn: 中古英语 hevy 仍指重量。

items.en: Heavily first described moving with weight.
items.cn: heavily 起初描写带着重量移动。

items.en: It widened to mean in large amounts.
items.cn: 词义扩展到数量很大。

items.en: It also came to mean seriously or greatly.
items.cn: 也表示严重地、在很大程度上。

note.en: Heavily is compared with look-alike words and with words for strong degree.
note.cn: 把 heavily 与形近词以及表示程度强的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heavily turns weight into a way of doing things.
normalIntro.cn: heavily 把重量变成了一种做事的方式。

normal.en: It rained heavily all night.
He was breathing heavily.
The area was heavily damaged.
She leaned heavily on the rail.
The plan was heavily criticized.
normal.cn: 这个计划受到严厉批评。

abstract.en: What falls heavily leaves a mark.
abstract.cn: 落得重的东西，会留下痕迹。

abstract.en: Rain can be loud without being angry.
abstract.cn: 雨可以下得很大，却并不愤怒。

abstract.en: Weight is a way of insisting.
abstract.cn: 重量，是一种坚持的方式。

examples.en: It was raining heavily.
He walked heavily up the stairs.
The town was heavily damaged by the flood.
examples.cn: 这座镇子被洪水严重破坏。

dict_mnemonic.text: heavily 是 heavy 加 -ly；步子沉是「沉重地」，雨下得猛是「大量地」，损失大是「严重地」，核心都是「重」。

root: 由 heavy（重的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成；heavy 来自古英语 hefig（重的、被压住的），因此 heavily 的核心义始终是「以重的分量」。

sensesIntro.en: Heavily applies the idea of weight to movement, amount, and seriousness.
sensesIntro.cn: heavily 把「重量」用在动作、数量和程度上。

core.en: Each step landing with full weight.
core.cn: 每一步都带着完整的重量落地。

branches.en: Boots fall slowly on the stairs.
branches.cn: 靴子在楼梯上慢慢落下。

branches.en: Rain drums on the roof.
branches.cn: 雨点敲打着屋顶。

branches.en: Walls crack after the flood.
branches.cn: 洪水过后，墙裂了。

branches.en: A heavy walk sounds like heavy rain.
branches.cn: 沉重的脚步，听起来像大雨。

branches.en: What falls heavily can hurt what it hits.
branches.cn: 落得重的东西，会伤到它砸中的东西。

intro.en: Heavily is built from heavy, which also forms nouns and comparisons.
intro.cn: heavily 由 heavy 构成，heavy 还能构成名词与比较级。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He was heavily influenced by jazz.

definition_en: weighing a lot, great in amount or force, or difficult to bear
core_image: 一个人双手抱着箱子，腰被压得往下沉
scene: 这个箱子太重了，一个人搬不动。The box is too heavy for one person to lift.
sceneCN: 这里 heavy 是「重的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这个箱子太重了，一个人搬不动。

derivatives.zh: 重量级人物；重量级拳手

senses.title: Weighing a lot
senses.definition: weighing a lot and hard to lift
senses.definitionCN: 分量大、难以搬动的
senses.example: The box is too heavy for one person to lift.
senses.exampleCN: 这个箱子太重了，一个人搬不动。
senses.why: This is weight you can feel in your arms.
senses.whyCN: 这是手臂能感觉到的重量。

senses.title: Great in amount
senses.definition: large in amount or force
senses.definitionCN: 数量大或力度强的
senses.example: Heavy rain fell all night.
senses.why: Falling water has weight too.
senses.whyCN: 落下的水同样有重量。

senses.title: Hard to bear
senses.definition: difficult to deal with, or sad
senses.definitionCN: 难以承受的，或令人难过的
senses.example: She went home with a heavy heart.
senses.why: Sadness sits on the chest like a weight.
senses.whyCN: 悲伤像重物一样压在胸口。

intro.en: Heavy comes from Old English hefig, weighed down.
intro.cn: heavy 来自古英语 hefig，意为被压住的。

items.en: Hefig meant heavy or weighed down.
items.cn: hefig 意为重的、被压住的。

items.en: It shared a root with heave.
items.cn: 它与 heave 共用一个词根。

items.en: Hevy kept the sense of great weight.
items.cn: 中古英语 hevy 仍指分量重。

items.en: Heavy described rain, traffic, and work.
items.cn: heavy 开始形容雨、交通与工作。

items.en: A heavy heart named deep sadness.
items.cn: a heavy heart 指深深的悲伤。

note.en: Heavy is compared with look-alike words and with words for great weight.
note.cn: 把 heavy 与形近词以及表示分量大的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heavy is weight in the arms, in the weather, and in the chest.
normalIntro.cn: heavy 是手臂里的重量、天气里的分量，也是胸口的沉重。

normal.en: This bag is heavier than mine.
Heavy traffic delayed the bus.
normal.cn: 拥堵的交通让公交晚点了。

normal.en: She is a heavy smoker.
The news left him with a heavy heart.
normal.cn: 这个消息让他心情沉重。

normal.en: Heavy industry needs a lot of power.

abstract.en: Weight is how strongly the earth holds you.
abstract.cn: 重量，是大地抓住你的力道。

abstract.en: Some words are heavy before they are spoken.
abstract.cn: 有些话，在说出口之前就很重。

abstract.en: Rain is the sky becoming heavy.
abstract.cn: 下雨，是天空变重了。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for one person to lift.
examples.cn: 这个箱子太重了，一个人搬不动。

examples.en: Heavy rain fell all night.
She went home with a heavy heart.

dict_mnemonic.text: heavy 的本义是「压手」；东西压手是重，雨点压下来是大，工作压在身上是繁重，心情压着胸口是沉重。

root: 来自古英语 hefig（重的、被压住的），与 heave（举起）同源；由物体的重量，引申为数量与力度之大，再比喻精神上的负担与悲伤。

sensesIntro.en: Heavy is what you cannot lift easily, what comes in great amounts, and what presses on the heart.
sensesIntro.cn: heavy 是不容易搬起的东西、来势很大的事物，以及压在心上的事。

core.en: A box pulling the arms straight down.
core.cn: 一个把手臂直往下坠的箱子。

branches.en: The box will not move.
branches.cn: 这个箱子纹丝不动。

branches.en: Water pours down in sheets.
branches.cn: 雨水成片地泼下来。

branches.en: A long sigh fills the room.
branches.cn: 一声长叹充满房间。

branches.en: Water too can be heavy enough to stop you.
branches.cn: 水重起来，也能把你拦住。

branches.en: Bad news arrives like bad weather.
branches.cn: 坏消息来得像坏天气。

intro.en: Heavy takes comparison and builds adverb and noun forms.
intro.cn: heavy 有比较级，并构成副词与名词形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He left with a heavy heart.

definition_en: the distance from bottom to top, how tall a person is, a high place, or the peak of something
core_image: 从地面垂直量到头顶的一条线
scene: 他的身高超过一米九。His height is over one metre ninety.
sceneCN: 这里 height 是「身高」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他的身高超过一米九。

senses.title: How tall
senses.definition: the distance from the bottom to the top of a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 人或物从底部到顶部的距离
senses.example: His height is over one metre ninety.
senses.why: This is a measurement.
senses.whyCN: 这是一个测量值。

senses.title: A high place
senses.definition: a high place or area of high ground
senses.definitionCN: 高的地方或高地区域
senses.example: The village sits at a height of two thousand metres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子坐落在两千米的高处。
senses.why: The measurement becomes a location.
senses.whyCN: 测量值在这里变成了地点。

senses.title: The peak
senses.definition: the strongest or highest point of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物最强或最高的时刻
senses.example: The market was at its height in autumn.
senses.why: A tall thing reaches its top, and so does a trend.
senses.whyCN: 高的东西有顶端，趋势也有顶端。

intro.en: Height comes from Old English hiehþu, highness.
intro.cn: height 来自古英语 hiehþu，意为高的状态。

items.en: Hiehþu named being high.
items.cn: hiehþu 指高的状态。

items.en: It shared a root with high.
items.cn: 它与 high 共用一个词根。

entries.definition: measuring a lot from bottom to top

normalIntro.en: Height measures up, then points to a high place, then to a peak in time.
normalIntro.cn: height 先向上量，再指向高处，最后指时间上的顶点。

normal.en: What is your height?
The tree grew to a great height.
We climbed to a height above the clouds.
normal.cn: 我们爬到了云层之上的高处。

normal.en: It happened at the height of summer.
Her fame was at its height then.
normal.cn: 那时她的名气正处顶峰。

abstract.en: Height is a line drawn by gravity's opposite.
abstract.cn: 高度，是逆着重力画出的一条线。

abstract.en: Every peak is also a place to fall from.
abstract.cn: 每个顶点，也是可以跌落的地方。

abstract.en: We measure height, but we feel depth.
abstract.cn: 我们量得出高度，却只能感受深度。

examples.en: His height is over one metre ninety.
The village sits at a height of two thousand metres.
examples.cn: 这个村子坐落在两千米的高处。

examples.en: The market was at its height in autumn.

dict_mnemonic.text: height 与 high 同源，核心是「高」；量出来是身高、高度，站上去是高处，到了最上面就是顶点，如盛夏与名气的顶峰。

root: 来自古英语 hiehþu（高的状态），与 high 同源；由垂直的测量值，引申为高处与高地，再引申为事物发展的高峰。

sensesIntro.en: Height is a measurement, a high place, or the strongest point of a thing.
sensesIntro.cn: height 是一个测量值、一处高地，或事物的最高点。

core.en: A straight line from floor to crown.
core.cn: 从地面到头顶的一条直线。

branches.en: A mark is made on the wall.
branches.cn: 墙上画下一道记号。

branches.en: A village rests far above the valley.
branches.cn: 村子远在山谷之上。

branches.en: The season reaches its warmest week.
branches.cn: 季节到了最热的一周。

branches.en: The measure becomes a place to stand.
branches.cn: 测量值成了可以站立的地方。

branches.en: A mountain top is a height in space and in time.
branches.cn: 山顶既是空间的高处，也是时间的高点。

intro.en: Height has a plural and builds a verb and related forms.
intro.cn: height 有复数形式，并能构成动词与相关形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is altus, high, as in altitude.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 altus（高），见于 altitude。

items.example: It was at the height of the storm.

items.example: The town is busy at the height of summer.

latinEntries.example: The plane flew at high altitude.

definition_en: a place of punishment after death, or a word used for swearing and emphasis
core_image: 地下燃着火焰、罪人受罚的地方
scene: 他相信坏人死后会下地狱。He believed that bad people go to hell after death.
sceneCN: 这里 hell 是「地狱」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他相信坏人死后会下地狱。

senses.title: Place of punishment
senses.definition: a place where bad people are said to be punished after death
senses.definitionCN: 传说中坏人死后受罚的地方
senses.example: He believed that bad people go to hell after death.
senses.exampleCN: 他相信坏人死后会下地狱。
senses.why: This is the old religious sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是该词古老的宗教义项。

senses.title: Swear word
senses.definition: used in angry speech as a swear word
senses.definitionCN: 在恼怒时用作咒骂语
senses.example: Oh hell, I forgot my keys.
senses.why: Anger borrows the worst place people can name.
senses.whyCN: 愤怒时会借用人们能想到的最糟的地方。

senses.title: For emphasis
senses.definition: used after question words to add force
senses.definitionCN: 用在疑问词后加强语气
senses.example: What the hell are you doing?
senses.why: The swear word becomes a way to push a question.
senses.whyCN: 咒骂词变成了加重疑问的说法。

intro.en: Hell is a Germanic word for a hidden world under the earth.
intro.cn: hell 是日耳曼语词，指地下隐蔽的世界。

items.en: The root meant a hidden or covered place.
items.cn: 该词根意为被遮盖的地方。

items.en: Hell named the underworld of the dead.
items.cn: hell 指死者的地下世界。

items.en: The Norse Hel named a goddess and her realm.
items.cn: 古北欧语 Hel 既是女神也是她的国度。

items.en: Hell became the general word for a place of punishment.
items.cn: hell 成为惩罚之地的通称。

items.en: Hell turned into a swear word and an intensifier.
items.cn: hell 发展为咒骂词和加强语气的词。

note.en: Hell is compared with look-alike words and with words for terrible places.
note.cn: 把 hell 与形近词以及表示可怕之地的词作比较。

entries.definition: the wheel or handle of a ship

normalIntro.en: Hell is the dark place below, and also a word for anger and emphasis.
normalIntro.cn: hell 是地下的黑暗之地，也是表达恼怒和加强语气的词。

normal.en: He believed that bad people go to hell.
Oh hell, I forgot my keys.
What the hell are you doing?
The kitchen was hot as hell.
War can turn a city into hell.
normal.cn: 战争能把城市变成地狱。

abstract.en: Hell is often a place people build for each other.
abstract.cn: 地狱常常是人给人造出来的地方。

abstract.en: The road to hell is wide and easy to walk.
abstract.cn: 通往地狱的路又宽又好走。

abstract.en: Even hell is said to have its own weather.
abstract.cn: 据说连地狱也有自己的天气。

examples.en: He believed that bad people go to hell after death.
examples.cn: 他相信坏人死后会下地狱。

examples.en: Oh hell, I forgot my keys.
What the hell are you doing?

dict_mnemonic.text: hell 是「地狱」，也可作咒骂的「见鬼」，还可用在疑问词后加强语气，如 what the hell（到底）；go to hell 是下地狱，raise hell 是大吵大闹。

root: 来自古英语 hell，与古北欧语 Hel 同源，本义指被遮盖的地下世界；由死者的居所引申为惩罚之地，再发展出咒骂与加强语气的用法。

sensesIntro.en: Hell is a place of punishment, a swear word, or a way to add force to a question.
sensesIntro.cn: hell 是地狱、咒骂语，或加强疑问语气的词。

core.en: A hidden world below, which became a place of punishment.
core.cn: 地下的隐蔽世界，后来成为惩罚之地。

branches.en: He believed that bad people go to hell.
branches.cn: 他相信坏人会下地狱。

branches.en: Oh hell, I forgot my keys.
branches.cn: 见鬼，我忘带钥匙了。

branches.en: What the hell are you doing?
branches.cn: 你到底在干什么？

branches.en: The worst place becomes the strongest word.
branches.cn: 最糟的地方变成了语气最重的词。

branches.en: Anger and emphasis share the same short word.
branches.cn: 恼怒和强调共用同一个短词。

intro.en: Hell forms a small family of words for terrible places and fierce people.
intro.cn: hell 构成一小族词，表示可怕的地方和凶悍的人。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He talked about hell in his sermon.

items.exampleCN: 他们宣讲地狱之火与末日。

items.example: The boy was a famous hellraiser.
items.exampleCN: 那男孩是出了名的捣蛋鬼。

items.example: The flood made a hell on earth.
items.exampleCN: 洪水把那里变成了人间地狱。

definition_en: a greeting, or a word used to answer the phone or show surprise
core_image: 见面或接电话时脱口而出的招呼
scene: 她走进门，向每个人说你好。She walked in and said hello to everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 hello 是「你好」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她走进门，向每个人说你好。

senses.title: Greeting
senses.definition: a word you say when you meet someone
senses.definitionCN: 见到别人时说的问候语
senses.example: She said hello to everyone in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她向屋里的每个人问好。
senses.why: This is the everyday greeting sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常打招呼的义项。

senses.title: On the phone
senses.definition: a word used when answering the telephone
senses.definitionCN: 接电话时使用的词
senses.example: Hello, who is speaking?
senses.why: The greeting became the standard phone answer.
senses.whyCN: 问候语成了接电话的标准开场。

senses.title: Surprise
senses.definition: a word used to show surprise or interest
senses.definitionCN: 表示惊讶或兴趣的词
senses.example: Hello, what is this doing here?
senses.exampleCN: 咦，这东西怎么会在这儿？
senses.why: A greeting can also catch someone's attention.
senses.whyCN: 招呼语也能用来引起别人的注意。

intro.en: Hello grew out of old shouts used to call attention.
intro.cn: hello 由古老的、用来引起注意的喊声发展而来。

items.en: Hola was a shout used to call someone.
items.cn: hola 是招呼人的喊声。

items.en: Hallow and hallo were shouts for attention.
items.cn: hallow 和 hallo 是引人注意的喊声。

items.en: Hello appeared as a friendly greeting.
items.cn: hello 作为友好的问候出现。

items.en: The telephone made hello a standard answer.
items.cn: 电话使 hello 成为标准接听语。

items.en: Hello also became a word of surprise.
items.cn: hello 也成为表示惊讶的词。

note.en: Hello is compared with look-alike words and with other greetings.
note.cn: 把 hello 与形近词以及其他问候语作比较。

entries.definition: a friendly hello in American English

normalIntro.en: Hello greets a person, answers a phone, or voices surprise.
normalIntro.cn: hello 用来问候别人、接电话，或表达惊讶。

normal.en: She said hello to everyone in the room.
normal.cn: 她向屋里的每个人问好。

normal.en: Hello, who is speaking?

normal.cn: 咦，这东西怎么会在这儿？

normal.en: He waved hello from across the street.
normal.cn: 他在街对面挥手打招呼。

normal.en: Say hello to your parents for me.

abstract.en: Hello is a small door that opens a conversation.
abstract.cn: hello 是打开一段对话的一扇小门。

abstract.en: A hello costs nothing and can change a day.
abstract.cn: 一声问候不花分文，却能改变一天。

abstract.en: Every hello hides the chance of a goodbye.

examples.en: She walked in and said hello to everyone.

examples.en: Hello, who is speaking?

root: hello 是十九世纪出现的招呼语，来自更早的 hallo、holla 一类喊声，本用于引人注意；电话普及后，它成为通用的问候与接听用语。

sensesIntro.en: Hello is a greeting, a phone answer, or a cry of surprise.
sensesIntro.cn: hello 是问候语、接电话用语，或表示惊讶的喊声。

core.en: A shout that became the friendliest word at a door or on a phone.
core.cn: 一声喊叫，成了门口和电话里最亲切的词。

branches.en: She said hello to everyone in the room.
branches.cn: 她向屋里的每个人问好。

branches.en: Hello, who is speaking?
branches.cn: 喂，请问是哪位？

branches.en: Hello, what is this doing here?
branches.cn: 咦，这东西怎么会在这儿？

branches.en: The same word greets a face and a voice.
branches.cn: 同一个词，既招呼面前的人，也招呼电话里的声音。

branches.en: A phone answer can turn into a surprised question.
branches.cn: 一句接听语可以变成惊讶的追问。

intro.en: Hello mostly appears in short phrases and in its plural form.
intro.cn: hello 主要出现在短语和复数形式中。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is a modern shout.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，是近代的喊声。

items.example: She said hello at the door.
The room was full of hellos.
They were helloing at the gate.

items.meaning: to greet by moving the hand

items.exampleCN: 她在公交车上挥手打招呼。

items.example: Hello again, are you waiting too?

definition_en: to make things easier for someone, or to be useful
core_image: 伸出手把重担分担一半
scene: 她帮奶奶把菜提上楼。She helped her grandmother carry the vegetables upstairs.
sceneCN: 这里 help 是「帮助」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她帮奶奶把菜提上楼。

senses.title: Give aid
senses.definition: to do something that makes it easier for someone
senses.definitionCN: 做某事使别人轻松一些
senses.example: She helped her grandmother carry the vegetables.
senses.why: This is the basic action of lending a hand.
senses.whyCN: 这是伸手相助的基本义。

senses.title: Be useful
senses.definition: to improve a situation or make something possible
senses.definitionCN: 改善情况或使某事成为可能
senses.example: Fresh air helps you sleep.
senses.why: A thing can lend a hand as well as a person.
senses.whyCN: 不只是人能帮忙，事物也能起作用。

senses.title: Aid
senses.definition: the act of helping, or a person or thing that helps
senses.definitionCN: 帮助的行为，或提供帮助的人或物
senses.example: Your advice was a great help.
senses.why: The verb becomes a noun for the aid itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词，指帮助本身。

intro.en: Help is an old Germanic word for giving aid.
intro.cn: help 是古老的日耳曼语词，意为给予帮助。

items.en: The root meant to aid or support.
items.cn: 该词根意为援助或支持。

items.cn: help 也成为名词。

items.en: The phrase can't help became common.
items.cn: can't help 这一说法变得常见。

note.en: Help is compared with look-alike words and with words for aid.

normalIntro.en: Help is a hand lent to another, and also anything that makes life easier.
normalIntro.cn: help 是伸向别人的一只手，也是任何让生活轻松一点的东西。

abstract.en: A hand offered in time is worth more than a speech.

abstract.en: To help is to admit that no one stands alone.

examples.en: She helped her grandmother carry the vegetables upstairs.

branches.en: Fresh air helps you sleep.
branches.cn: 新鲜空气有助于睡眠。

branches.en: Your advice was a great help.

branches.cn: 帮助的动作和得到的帮助共用一个词。

definition_en: the object form of she, or a word showing that something belongs to her
